newsitem.title: USA: Teamsters' Carey repeats he willing to talk to UPS.
newsitem.headline: Teamsters' Carey repeats he willing to talk to UPS.

text.p: Teamsters union President Ron Carey repeated on Monday he was ready to go back to the bargaining table with United Parcel Service.

"I have never refused to talk," he told reporters after meeting with Labour Secretary Alexis Herman. "I think what I'm saying here today is I'm ready at any time and any place to talk," he said after a two-hour conversation with Herman in her office in the Labour Department.
:Teamsters' Carey repeats he willing to talk to UPS
Carey said over the weekend that further talks with UPS would be fruitless because the company had been unwilling to alter its "last, best and final" offer.
He repeated on Monday that he did not want to waste any more time in dead-end negotiations.
"I'm not going to spend any more time out there chit-chatting," Carey said.
The 184,000 Teamsters entered the second week of their strike against UPS on Monday.
